notes.title: Adding functions such as Material Reset, Look At, and Physics Simplification Opt
notes.content:
Material Reset 
After unchecking the "Enable Material Settings" option in the material panel, a reset button will appear. Clicking it will reset the material settings.
 Look At Camera 
By checking the "Look At" option in the camera panel, the model will continuously face the camera. Physics Simplification Option 
When loading, overly complex models will undergo automatic physics simplification, which may affect physical performance. This operation can be undone for the model on the "Model" - "Modify" page.

notes.title: Add VR joint touch interaction
notes.content:
Add VR joint touch interaction
The VR mode adds movable joints to the MMD model, allowing you to use handles to pose various poses or do other interesting things for your favorite characters in the virtual world.

After importing the model, enter VR mode, press the function key on the left handle to call up the menu, and then press the "palm" shaped switch to activate this function.
After approaching the joints such as hands, feet, and waist, operation prompts will appear. Press the grip button on the handle to operate.
(This feature currently only supports PMX format models)
